logp.method_description: The LogPO/W value was determined by the shaking bottle method. Ir1-Ir4 was added to the mixed solution of n-octanol/buffered aqueous solution at pH 7.40 (1:1, v/v), and the mixed solution was shaken at 37 ℃ at 200 rpm for 24 h to achieve the distribution balance between n-octanol and buffered aqueous solution. The octanol phase and the water phase were then separated by centrifugation (3000 rpm, 10 min) and collected. The content of Ir(III) in water and oil phases was determined by ICP-MS(NEXION-300X, PerkinElmer, USA). The LogPO/W value is calculated by the following formula: LogPO/W = Log([Ir]O/[Ir]W)
